Session.description: A Socialytics sign-in session token, for Moburst staff only.

info.description: Everything Socialytics holds for the clients a key may see (clients with their brand, pillars and design, social and competitive reports with their decks, competitor sets, generated posts and media, schedules, scheduled posts, competitive alerts, design systems, Sprout performance, health), the actions people start in the app (start a social or competitive report, draft a post, write a post's copy again, start a post's designs, propose competitors, refresh the competitor feed, plan a calendar week; the run scope, with an optional idempotency_key), plus the ad-hoc demo job that onboards any brand from a name and a website and runs every feature for it, and what Socialytics' paid providers cost per client, service and period (the costs scope). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The personal key routes under /v1/me take a Socialytics sign-in session instead, for Moburst staff only. Lists are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`.
